description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of Git's submodule fetch functionality, including recursive fetches, config overrides, and error conditions.

methods.name: write_expected_sub
methods.description: Generates expected error output for fetching a submodule 'submodule' at a specific commit.

methods.name: write_expected_sub2
methods.description: Generates expected error output for fetching a second submodule 'submodule2' at a specific commit.

methods.name: write_expected_deep
methods.description: Generates expected error output for fetching a deep submodule.

methods.name: write_expected_super
methods.description: Generates expected error output for fetching a superproject.

methods.name: add_submodule_commits
methods.description: Creates new commits in submodules and writes the expected fetch error outputs.

methods.name: add_superproject_commits
methods.description: Updates the superproject and its submodules, creating new commits and corresponding expected outputs.

methods.name: verify_fetch_result
methods.description: Verifies that the actual fetch error output matches the expected concatenated output.

methods.name: add_commit_push
methods.description: Adds files, commits, and pushes in a specified repository.

methods.name: compare_refs_in_dir
methods.description: Compares the commit references between two directories/repos.

methods.name: fetch_with_recursion_abort
methods.description: Performs a fetch with recursion into submodules, terminating on detection of infinite recursion with sed.
